description: The recorded Starfold run on the APOGEE DR19 example table (9,242 stars, eight chemo-dynamical columns), with the two-dimensional map HDBSCAN cut, for the interactive demo at /software/starfold-demo/.

run.hardware_in_tutorial: laptop NVIDIA RTX 3060 with RAPIDS cuML (docs/tutorial/apogee.md)

table.values: float32 as stored in the table, unchanged
table.use: The provenance note calls the bundled table a convenience and says not to use it for scientific work; anything citable must be rebuilt from APOGEE and Gaia.

map.check: the refit's labels equal the recorded labels for every star

calibration.check: the record's observed statistic equals the run's exploration_max exactly
calibration.attached_to_run: no; attaching it with --update-result would add the flag no_structure_supported

derived.refit matches: each group's match is the refit group with the largest Jaccard index, ties to the lowest id (as for recurrence); a refit group matched to no group has no counterpart
examples: the member of group 0 nearest, in the eight standardised columns, to the group's median over the refits
the member of group 1 nearest, in the eight standardised columns, to the group's median over the refits
the star whose second-largest support for a group is the largest of all stars
the unassigned star with the median unresolved share among unassigned stars
derived.column statistics: mean, standard deviation (ddof 0) and linear percentiles over all stars
